【原视频简介】
You probably know what happens if you delete all textures in Minecraft, you get the purple checkerboard texture, but what happens if you delete even that? Does the game crash or display some cursed visuals? It is time to find out by removing the fallback texture from the game as well and test a few versions including the legacy console and bedrock editions.
